findings.title: Call to conditional-passkey helper has no matching overload
findings.body: `UsernameForm` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but the helper added in its superclass is `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`. No no-argument overload is defined in this class hierarchy shown by this change, so the services module will fail to compile. Pass `context.getUser()` (or add a deliberate no-argument overload) before merging.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys are disabled for unauthenticated initial logins
findings.body: The new helper returns false whenever `user` is null. `authenticate()` now relies exclusively on this helper before calling `webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context)`, but a normal initial UsernamePasswordForm login has no context user. As a result, the WebAuthn challenge and conditional-UI form attributes are no longer populated on the initial login page, so passkey conditional UI will not render or authenticate until a user is already selected. The previous code explicitly initialized WebAuthn in the `context.getUser() == null` branch; initialization needs to remain enabled for both anonymous initial login and re-authentication.
